title: Project config — the project-specific value table for the portable agentic layer
description: Validated in CI. The portable layer (agents/core, agents/_shared, docs/agent-rules, docs/harness, generic scripts) reads ONLY from here; reuse in another project = rewrite project.config.json against this schema. See docs/PORTABILITY.md.

literals.description: Project-specific identifiers that must NOT appear in portable files (the portable-purity denylist seed). Names, dirs, target/interface symbols.

msvc_toolset_pin.description: Optional, Windows-only. MSVC toolset version (major.minor) to pin vcvars64 to on a multi-VS box, so a newer side-by-side toolset doesn't load STL headers that break the cached cl.exe (STL1001). Read by scripts/dev/with-msvc-env.sh (bash) and scripts/dev/local/build-msvc-asan.sh; overridable via $SMATCHET_VCVARS_VER.

protected_branches.description: Branches the stale-branch sweep (git-janitor) must NEVER delete even with no open PR — load-bearing infra (e.g. a relay/asset-host branch referenced by committed code). Mechanism is portable; this list is the project-specific value.

branch_protection.description: Desired GitHub branch-protection state for the default branch, codified so it can't drift. Applied by agents/scripts/core/setup-branch-protection.sh, which PUTs the FULL object — a REPLACE, not a patch — so an optional flag absent from this block is reset to its API default (false) on every apply. This block must therefore be the COMPLETE desired state over the PUT body surface: state each optional flag explicitly, even when false. Complete over the PUT body, NOT over every key the GET returns — required_signatures is deliberately absent because it is not a PUT body parameter (GitHub owns it via the protection/required_signatures sub-resource). See docs/adr/0013-solo-no-required-review.md for why required_review_count is 0.

required_checks_app_id.description: GitHub App id allowed to satisfy the required checks (15368 = GitHub Actions). Projected into the wire's required_status_checks.checks[] form as {context, app_id}. Load-bearing: the deprecated contexts[] form carries no app id, so a PUT built from it leaves EVERY required context unpinned with no recorded intent — a silent loosening of who can turn a required gate green. Three values, not two, and they are NOT synonyms: a positive id PINS the check to that app; -1 is the explicit 'any app may set this status' spelling; null omits the app_id key, which makes GitHub AUTO-SELECT the app that most recently provided that context (any source only if no app ever set it). Omission is auto-selection, not 'any app'. The three states come from the three VALUES, never from the key's presence: the key is listed in this block's `required` array, so deleting it fails validation rather than reading as a fourth spelling of auto-selection.

required_conversation_resolution.description: Every PR conversation must be resolved before merge. Load-bearing and NOT substitutable by the harness: merge-gates.sh and scripts/dev/pr-blocked-why.sh probe it as ground truth for a silent-BLOCKED PR, and it counts bot review threads the gate-poller deliberately filters out.

ci.description: CI path filters only. The required-checks list lives solely in branch_protection.required_contexts (single source); project-config.sh derives CI_REQUIRED_CHECKS from it.

coverage.description: Numeric line-coverage gate config (coverage.yml). See coverage-threshold-graduation.

agents.description: Project agent registry + agent-prompt size budgets (agent_size_audit.py). The size_*/contract_*/sink_warn caps are delta-gated line budgets over the agentic docs; see reduce-agent-prompt-bloat Slice 0.

size_budget_lines.description: Hard cap (BLOCKS) for the agent-prompt class (agents/core, agents/project).

size_warn_lines.description: Soft-warn line count for the agent-prompt class (advisory).

contract_budget_lines.description: Hard cap (BLOCKS) for AGENTS.md (the every-session contract).

sink_warn_lines.description: Soft-warn-only line count for the sink classes (docs/agent-rules, agents/_shared/skills); never blocks.

review-panel.description: Review-panel roster (docs/agent-rules/review-panels.md § Roster). Read by agents/scripts/core/run-review.sh: one leg per (harness, model); the launcher passes <flag> <id> and names the output file <prefix>review-<round>-<harness>-<tag>.md.

start_dwell_secs.description: Startup stagger between same-harness legs (shared-config write race at CLI startup). Default 3.

tag.description: Short name used in the review filename.

id.description: The value passed to <flag> (the harness's real model id).
